Aegean · 25 November reported Turkish UAV activity

25 November 2026 · Aegean · 25 November reported Turkish UAV activity

Greek-authority daily airspace figures as reproduced in the Greek press

The Hellenic National Defence General Staff (GEETHA), as reported by OnAlert and Veteranos, listed three Turkish UAVs, four reported Greek national-airspace violations and three separate Athens FIR traffic-rule infringements on 25 November. The report covered the northeastern, central and southeastern Aegean. Routine identification and interception were reported; no engagement was listed.

The figures are separate measures in one daily military bulletin, not verified individual flight tracks or attack counts. Both reports cite the same bulletin; the official monthly table was not directly accessible at review.
